coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 CAST-128（CAST5）这一种 64 位 Feistel 分组密码：40–128 位可变密钥、12/16 轮、三种轮函数、8 个 S-box、32 个子密钥、RFC 2144 的三组向量和 1,000,000 次维护测试、CMS 与 OpenPGP 使用；不把 CAST 设计过程、DES、CAST-256、CMS/OpenPGP 协议或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the CAST-128 (CAST5) 64-bit Feistel block cipher: 40-128-bit variable keys, 12/16 rounds, three round-function types, eight S-boxes, 32 subkeys, the three RFC 2144 vectors and the 1,000,000-iteration maintenance test, and CMS/OpenPGP use. It does not absorb the CAST design procedure, DES, CAST-256, CMS/S/MIME, OpenPGP, modes of operation or the whole library.
